name: review-anvil
description: Iterative multi-agent code review with six cross-agent skills: review-anvil, review-anvil-readonly, review-anvil-pr, review-anvil-improve-pr, review-anvil-init, and review-anvil-rules. Includes source-backed local memory and automatically learned per-repository local rules without rule branches or PRs. PR pilot runs are comment-only and support no-post comparisons. Parallel reviewers verify findings; productive runs retain build/test gates and fix commits.
